name: Fear
description: You project a phantasmal image of a creature's worst fears. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and become frightened for the duration. A frightened creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns.
effect: A creature that fails a Wisdom save is frightened (disadvantage on its attacks) until it shakes it off.
notes: In combat: every enemy in a 30-foot cone toward the target makes its own Wisdom save; each that fails is frightened: its attacks have disadvantage. It saves again at the end of each of its turns. Concentration, 10 rounds.
